content.description: Welcome to the future. In September 1501 Pavia Italy was the birthplace of Gerolamo (Jerome) Cardano, whom the Cardano blockchain project was named after. 2021 sees the launch of Pavia.io which is a metaverse being built on Cardano. It seems fitting to name our virtual world Pavia. Thank you in advance! Become a digital land owner. The total Pavia.io NFT Lands available are 100,000. It is very important to explain that this metaverse project is in its infancy, these are the very early stages of development, this digital world will only succeed with the ongoing.
